name: Late Lunch, Early Dinner
source:
Late Lunch, Early Dinner is a visual novel about the perils of forgetting to set an alarm. You may end up oversleeping for a study session, and have to help your friends cram for their midterm on an empty stomach. You can only hold out for so long, and one of them's going to end up as your late lunch...or early dinner.

[From [url=https://roundroses.itch.io/late-lunch-early-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《晚午餐，早晚餐》是一部关于忘记设置闹钟的危险的视觉小说。你可能会在学习过程中睡过头，并且不得不帮助你的朋友空腹补习期中考试。你只能坚持这么长时间，其中一个最终会成为你迟到的午餐……或早到的晚餐。

[来自[url=https://roundroses.itch.io/late-lunch-early-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
